projects.name: Job Application Tracker
projects.summary: A Chrome extension that logs a job application to a Google Sheet in one click and archives the full job description as its own Google Doc before the posting disappears. Vanilla JavaScript on both ends — no frameworks, no build step, no hosting.
description: A Chrome extension (MV3) with a Google Apps Script backend. Vanilla JS with no build step. Side panel injects scraper into page and reads job fields off it to POST them into script. Script saves the description as Google Doc and appends info row to Google Sheet.
Scraping runs in three layers to achieve same result on multiple sites with different job views. 1) Site-specific selectors, 2) JSON-LD, 3) OpenGraph meta tags and Highlighted text.

projects.name: Twitter Video/GIF Downloader
projects.summary: A self-hostable web app that turns a Twitter link into a downloadable or shareable MP4/GIF using FFmpeg. FastAPI backend, vanilla-JS frontend, shipped as a Docker image.
description: Twitter does not allow for only the tweet media to be downloaded/shared. This allows a user to copy a link to a Twitter post with a video or GIF and download or share the transcoded file.

Uses a FastAPI backend with yt-dlp as a library to resolve a tweet's CDN URLs and enumerate available qualities. Videos are proxied through a server rather than linked directly (without this, mobile users would have the link opened directly instead of saving it).

Twitter transcodes GIFs into a silent, looping MP4. To transcode this into a GIF, I used FFmpeg palettegen/palletteuse transcode and stream the result back from a temp directory which is deleted after the response finishes. A Web Share API path is used to hand the file straight over to other mobile applications without needing to save.
